selection_rule: Deterministic adaptive round-robin across configured family strata. Only StillImage media with an exact license normalized to the configured media_license_allowlist are eligible. Families are visited in config order; each active family contributes at most one valid specimen per round. Families that exhaust accessible candidates are skipped, and remaining families continue until target_total is reached. No per-family quota is enforced.
